note: This project's OWN LLM call sites. It is the fleet's observability sink and also a caller; several of these sites spend without recording an event, which this declaration makes visible as a gap rather than leaving invisible.

use_cases.name: Freeform judge verdict
use_cases.description: Runs a schema-enforced pass/fail-style verdict against a single free-form prompt, with one repair re-ask before an unparseable verdict is a hard error.

use_cases.name: Free-form text generation
use_cases.description: Generates free-form text on Claude for anonymization rewrites and healing-pass paragraphs, shared by dataset scrubbing and benchmark healing.

use_cases.name: Rubric-weighted judge
use_cases.description: Judges one case against a structured rubric, averaging over self-consistency samples, with weighted dimensions and gating floors computed locally rather than trusted to the model.

use_cases.name: Pairwise A/B judge
use_cases.description: Judges which of two answers is better (or a tie), debiased by swapping the A/B order and requiring both orders to agree.

use_cases.name: Simple benchmark judge
use_cases.description: Judges each provided candidate output with a freeform rubric and a single overall score, in a benchmark run's simple mode.

use_cases.name: Rubric benchmark
use_cases.description: Runs per-dimension rubric judging (with self-consistency) across a benchmark's cases, aggregated into a report.

use_cases.name: Batched rubric judge
use_cases.description: Judges multiple cases in a single call (batching), amortizing per-call context, with a batch-wide failure retried unbatched so no case is lost.

use_cases.name: Multi-target compare benchmark
use_cases.description: Generates candidate outputs across multiple targets and judges them against the benchmark's cases to produce a comparative ranking.

use_cases.name: Pairwise round-robin matrix
use_cases.description: Runs the round-robin pairwise phase across benchmark targets and prints the resulting comparison matrix and ranking.

use_cases.name: Calibration re-judge
use_cases.description: Re-judges a human-labeled calibration set with the structured rubric or freeform criteria to measure judge/human agreement (Cohen's kappa).

use_cases.name: Calibration drift sentinel
use_cases.description: Periodically re-judges the golden calibration set to detect judge drift against the previous measured kappa, feeding the API's score-drop alerting.

use_cases.name: Batch-vs-single calibration compare
use_cases.description: Judges the same calibration items both singly and in batches to measure how batching shifts scores before an operator trusts batched judging for a rubric.

use_cases.name: Online scoring
use_cases.description: Judges live outputs as they arrive (online scoring path) and persists per-case scores.

use_cases.name: Ad-hoc scoring
use_cases.description: Judges an operator-supplied input/output pair on demand outside of a benchmark run, storing the resulting score.

use_cases.name: Trace scoring
use_cases.description: Judges recorded traces that have not already been scored, so replayed production traffic gets a quality score.

use_cases.name: LLM PII scrub pass
use_cases.description: After a deterministic regex scrub, optionally rewrites dataset text with an LLM pass to catch remaining PII (names, orgs, locations, account/order numbers) that the regex pass missed.

use_cases.name: Benchmark healing recommendations
use_cases.description: After a rubric benchmark run, asks the model to recommend concrete fixes (prompt, model, rubric changes) targeting the weakest-scoring dimensions.

use_cases.name: Relay task execution
use_cases.description: Executes one leased task by rendering its action's prompt and running the Claude Code CLI, then settles the outcome back to the relay.

use_cases.name: Alert investigation
use_cases.description: Runs a read-only Claude Code scan against a project's repo to diagnose the cause of an incoming alert/spike.

use_cases.name: Auto-fix act
use_cases.description: Runs an edit-mode Claude Code session against a project's repo to attempt an automatic fix for a diagnosed issue.
